tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// khro bo bcu'i bstod bskul bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' dbyings dag pa'i klong dkyil du// pam̐ las sna tshogs padma'i steng*// ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi// dbus su hūm̐ las byung ba yi// rgya chen sna tshogs rdo rje ni// shar dkar lho ser nub dmar zhing*// byang ljang lte ba mthing nag la// hūm̐ yig 'bar bas mtshan pa las// 'og tu 'od zer 'phros gyur pas// rgya dang rngams ni mtha' yas shing*// brtan zhing go skabs med pa yi// 'og phyogs rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur// oṃ me di nī badzrī bha wa bandha hūm̐ lam̐ hūm̐/ slar yang 'od zer rab 'phros pas// khor yug kun tu 'khor 'gyur zhing*// kha khyer rdo rje'i phreng ba can// rdo rje'i rwa ba brtan pa dang*// rdo rje 'greng bur gyur pa yi// rdo rje'i rwa bas yongs su bskor// slar yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// ri bo'i lhun ltar rab tu brtan// khog pa yangs shing rab brjid pa// rdo rje 'bar ba'i gur du gyur// hūm̐ las steng du 'od 'phros pas// nam mkha'i khams ni kun khyab cing*// 'bar ba'i me yi glog stong 'gyu// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi 'brug sgra sgrogs// bgegs la rdo rje'i char 'bebs pa'i// steng phyogs rdo rje'i bla rer gyur// phyi rol kun du 'od 'phros pas// 'jig pa'i dus kyi me lta bur// 'ur 'ur chil chil sgra sgrogs shing*// me stag skar mda' lta bur 'phro// kha dog sna tshogs kun du 'khrug /bdud dpung nges par sreg byed pa// sa dang nam mkha' kun khyab pa'i// 'bar ba'i me yi phung por gyur// hūm̐ he ru ka dpal rgyal po yi// gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i// bsrung ba'i dam tshig sbyor ba yis// rnal 'byor rtag tu srung bar byed// oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā// de yi dbus su pam̐ ram̐ las// padma nyi ma'i dbus gnas par// bhrūm̐ gyi yi ge gser mdog can// rab tu 'bar ba gyur pa las// rdo rje rin chen las grub pa// dgra bgegs phyi mar rlog phyed cing*// shin tu 'khor ba'i ngang tshul can// gser mdog yangs shing rgya che ba'i// rtsibs bcu ldan pa'i 'khor lor gyur// de yi dbus su padma dang*// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gdan steng du// bhrūm̐ las bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal// gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dpal// zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs kyang gnyis// gser mdog 'bar ba 'jigs chen po// spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can ste// sdigs mdzub dang ni 'khor lo 'dzin// stag dang sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yon brkyang ba yi gnas pas gnas// mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer gdong*// dpa' bo 'jigs byed sha tshugs can// skra dang ba spu'i bu ga nas// 'bar ba'i me stag 'phro zhing 'dzag

/hūm̐ gi 'brug sgra rnam par sgrogs// oṃ badzra aṣṇī ṣa tsakra warti hūm̐/ phyogs bcur sna tshogs padma dang*// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gdan steng du// hūm̐ dang rang mtshan las byung ba// khro bo'i rgyal po rnams su gyur// hūm̐ shar du dgra dang bgegs 'joms pa'i// khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed// sku mdog sngon po 'jigs chen po// spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can te// sdigs mdzub dang ni tho ba 'dzin// stag dang sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yon brkyang ba yi gnas pas gnas// mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer gdong*// dpa' bo 'jigs byed sha tshugs can// skra dang ba spu'i bu ga nas// 'bar ba'i me stag 'phro zhing 'dzag /hūm̐ gi 'brug sgra rnam par sgrogs// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// shar gyi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmugs shing mnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcings dang rengs pa yis// tshar gcad pa yi las mdzod cig /na maḥs manta buddhe bhyo na mo badzra muṅka ra hastā ya tsaṇḍa maṇḍa lā kṣe pa kā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ lho yi dgra dang bgegs 'joms pa'i// khro rgyal shes rab mthar byed ni// sku mdog dkar po 'jigs chen po// spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can te// sdigs mdzub dang ni be con 'dzin// stag dang sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yon brkyang ba yi gnas pas gnas// mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer gdong*// dpa' bo 'jigs byed sha tshugs can// skra dang ba spu'i bu ga nas// 'bar ba'i me stag 'phro zhing 'dzag /hūm̐ gi 'brug sgra rnam par sgrogs// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// lho yi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmugs shing mnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcings dang rengs pa yis// tshar gcad pa yi las mdzod cig

/na maḥs manta buddhe bhyo ma hā daṇḍa dha ra bi bi dā ra su ra a su rā marda na bhū ti nirma tha hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ nub tu dgra dang bgegs 'joms pa'i// khro rgyal padma mthar byed ni// sku mdog dmar mo 'jigs chen po// spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can te// sdig mdzub dang ni padma 'dzin// stag dang sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pas gnas// mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer gdong*// dpa' bo 'jigs byed sha tshugs can// skra dang ba spu'i bu ga nas// 'bar ba'i me stag 'phro zhing 'dzag /hūm̐ gi 'brug sgra rnam par sgrogs// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// nub gyi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmugs shing mnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcings dang rengs pa yis// tshar gcad pa yi las mdzod cig /na maḥs manta buddhe bhyo hu lu hu lu ma hā padma a mṛ te ku ru ma hā bi sha ni āḥ hūm̐ byang du dgra dang bgegs 'joms pa'i// khro bo'i rgyal po bgegs mthar byed// sku mdog nag po 'jigs chen po// spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can te// sdigs mdzub rdo rje rtse gsum 'dzin// stag dang sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yon brkyang ba yi gnas pas gnas// mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer gdong*// dpa' bo 'jigs byed sha tshugs can// skra dang ba spu'i bu ga nas// 'bar ba'i me stag 'phro zhing 'dzag /hūm̐ gi 'brug sgra rnam par sgrogs// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// byang gi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmugs shing mnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcings dang rengs pa yis// tshar gcad pa yi las mdzod cig

/na maḥs manta buddhe bhyo/ na mo badzra kro dhā ya ma hā dam̐ ṣṭotkā ṭa bhai ra wā ya badzra sa bo ha darpā ya a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ byang shar mtshams su bgegs 'joms pa'i// khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba// sku mdog sngon po 'jigs chen po// spyan gsum 'dzum khro'i tshul can te// sdigs mdzub dang ni ral gri 'dzin// rin chen sbrul dang dar gyis brgyan// g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pas gnas// sgeg cing dpa' ba'i cha byed can/ dbu skra nag po'i thor tshugs bcings// 'od kyi drwa ba 'gyed pa'o// shin tu rgya cher bzhad pa'i dbyangs// ha ha'i gad rgyangs rnam par sgrogs// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// byang shar mtshams kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpa' tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmugs shing mnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcings dang rengs pa yis// tshar gcad pa yi las mdzod cig /na ma ཿsa manta buddhe bhyo/ na mo a tsa la kā nā tsakra moṭṭa moṭṭa/ tuṭṭa tuṭṭa/ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ shar lho mtshams su bgegs 'joms pa'i// khro rgyal ṭakki rā dza ni// sku mdog sngon po 'jigs chen po// spyan gsum 'dzum khro'i tshul can te// sdigs mdzub dang ni lcags kyu 'dzin// rin chen sbrul dang dar gyis brgyan// g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pas gnas// sgeg cing dpa' ba'i cha byad can// dbu skra nag po'i thor tshugs bcings// 'od kyi drwa ba 'gyed pa po// shin tu rgya cher bzhad pa'i dbyangs// ha ha'i gad rgyangs rnam par sgrogs// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// shar lho mtshams kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpa' tshad bye ba'i pha rol tu// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmugs shing mnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcings dang rengs pa yis// tshar gcad pa'i las mdzod cig

/na maḥs manta buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐ lho nub mtshams su bgegs 'joms pa// khro bo'i rgyal po dbyug sngon can// sku mdog sngon po 'jigs chen po// spyan gsum 'dzum khro'i tshul can te// sdigs mdzub dang ni dbyug to 'dzin// rin chen sbrul dang dar gyis brgyan// g.yon brkyang ba yi gnas pas gnas// sgeg cing dpa' ba'i cha byad can// dbu skra nag po'i thor tshugs bcings// 'od kyi drwa ba 'gyed pa po// shin tu rgya cher bzhad pa'i dbyangs// ha ha'i gad rgyangs rnam par sgrogs// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// lho nub mtshams kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol tu// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmugs shing mnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcings dang rengs pa yis// tshar gcad pa yi las mdzod cig /na maḥs manta buddhe bhyaḥ oṃ ya ma daṇḍā ya/ nī la daṇḍā ya/ tu ru tu ru/ mu ru mu ru/ sarba duṣṭan/ mā ra ya mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ nub byang mtshams su bgegs 'joms pa// khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che// sku mdog sngon po 'jigs chen po// spyan gsum 'dzum khro'i tshul can te// sdigs mdzub dang ni rdo rje 'dzin// rin chen sbrul dang dar gyis brgyan// g.yon brkyang ba yi gnas pas gnas// sgeg cing dpa' ba'i cha byad can// dbu skra nag po'i thor thugs bcings// 'od kyi drwa ba 'gyed pa po// shin tu rgya cher bzhad pa'i dbyangs// ha ha'i gad rgyangs rnam par sgrogs// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// nub byang mtshams kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol tu// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmugs shing mnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcings dang rengs pa yis// tshar gcad pa yi las mdzod cig

/na maḥs manta buddhe bhyoḥ na mo ma hā ba lā ya/ utstshuṣma kro dha rā dzā ya/ sarbā nā gā nāṃ hṛ da yaṃ ta ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ steng gi phyogs kyi bgegs 'joms pa// khro bo'i rgyal po hūm̐ mdzad ni// sku mdog sngon po 'jigs chen po// spyan gsum drag po'i tshul can te// rdo rje dang ni dril bu 'dzin// stag dang sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pas gnas// mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer gdong*// dpa' bo 'jigs byed sha tshugs can// skra dang ba spu'i bu ga nas// 'bar ba'i me stag 'phro zhing 'dzag /hūm̐ gi 'brug sgra rnam par sgrogs// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// steng gi phyogs kyi bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol du// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmugs shing mnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcings dang rengs pa yis// tshar gcad pa yi las mdzod cig /oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ 'og gi dgra dang bgegs 'joms pa// khro bo'i rgyal po gnod mdzes ni// sku mdog sngon po 'jigs chen po// spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can te// sdigs mdzub dang ni gtun shing 'dzin// stag dang sbrul gyis rnam par brgyan// g.yon brkyang pa yi gnas pas gnas// mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer gdong*// dpa' bo 'jigs byed sha tshugs can// skra dang bu spu'i bu ga nas// 'bar ba'i me stag 'phro zhing 'dzag /hūm̐ gi 'brug sgra rnam par sgrogs// rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa yi// pho nya bskal pa'i me ltar 'phro// nam mkha' khyab pa dang bcas pas// gdug cing sdang ba'i sems ldan pa'i// 'og gi phyogs kyis bgegs tshogs kun// dpag tshad bye ba'i pha rol tu// rlung gi shugs kyis bskrad pa dang*// rab tu rmugs shing mnan pa dang*// gzir dang bcings dang rengs pa yis// tshar gcad pa yi las mdzod cig

/oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ grihna grihna hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ grihnā pa ya grihnā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho/ bha ga wāṃ badzra rā dza hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis// dgra dang bgegs kyi tshogs rnams kun// lus ni rdul du brlag par gyis// rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol// rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal po yi// gnyis med ye shes las byung ba'i// bsrung ba'i dam tshig sbyor ba yis// rnal 'byor rtag tu srung bar byed// rdo rje khro bo'i phrin las la// bskul ba'i tshul 'di 'phags pa yis// sa pho rta yi rgyal zla la// pho brang dam par sbyar ba yin// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
